quote: I believe that those MLAs that share the city and the rural area around it are richer for that experience.
note: match=direction. Former MP for Red Deer / Red Deer-Mountain View. Main request is about Sylvan Lake (to Lacombe) and a Highway 2/21 rural riding. I believe that those MLAs that share the city and the rural area around it are richer for that experience. I believe in the hub-and-spoke concept of it.' An endorsement of city-country sharing for Red Deer from experience, not an explicit request to redraw the provincial seats; a narrower reader would code 1. maj=3
